command: pip install -q edge-tts && python3 -c "import asyncio, edge_tts; asyncio.run(edge_tts.Communicate(\"Hello Boo, this is a cloud voice test\", \"ja-JP-NanamiNeural\").save(\"/tmp/voice-test1.mp3\"))" && ls -la /tmp/voice-test1.mp3 && python3 -c "import base64; d=open(\"/tmp/voice-test1.mp3\",\"rb\").read(); print(\"MP3_BYTES:\", len(d)); print(\"MP3_B64_HEAD:\", base64.b64encode(d[:60]).decode())" && cp /tmp/voice-test1.mp3 cloud-pc/storage/voice-test1.mp3 && echo STORED_OK
